metaDescription: adult cat booster schedule: timing table, what to do if a dose is late, and reminders before boosters are due.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters
paragraphs: This adult cat plan sequences doses against indoor-only assumptions, not against a vague “sometime this season” intention for your cat.

Milestone labels on the adult cat table (~1 year after kitten series; Per product & law; Lifestyle-dependent) are operational deadlines for daycare, boarding, travel, and multi-pet intros — a nearly finished adult cat kitten series is still incomplete.

If your household also wrestles with multi-cat felv status or lost clinic reminders, put those constraints on the same calendar thread as the FVRCP adult booster so one reminder system owns the adult cat week.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: Call the clinic with product names and prior dates the day you notice a missed adult cat dose; catch-up timing depends on age and gap length for this cat scenario.
Until the adult cat series is current again, reduce the exposure pattern that matches indoor-only assumptions, and do not wait for an annual wellness slot to ask about a adult cat make-up dose.
After the visit, enable 7-, 3-, and 1-day nudges for the next FVRCP adult booster due date so the same adult cat miss cannot hide inside a shared family calendar.

faqs.question: Is this adult cat booster schedule a prescription?
faqs.answer: No. It is an editorial planning table aligned with common AAHA/AAFP-style windows and facility patterns. Your veterinarian sets the legal and medical plan for the individual cat.

faqs.question: What if we already missed a date on this adult cat schedule?
faqs.answer: Contact the clinic for catch-up timing. Bring prior records, limit high-risk exposure tied to indoor-only assumptions, and reset reminders as soon as the next adult cat due date is known.

faqs.question: How do reminders help with FVRCP adult booster?
faqs.answer: PetClues can nudge you 7, 3, and 1 day before that adult cat booster is due so boarding and travel deadlines stop arriving as surprises.
